groups.title: House Stark
groups.def: Born a Stark (Ned, his brother Benjen and his children Robb, Sansa, Arya, Bran and Rickon), Jon (raised as Ned's bastard son, by blood Lyanna Stark's), or the wife of the house's head (Catelyn, Ned's; Talisa, Robb's); wards and allies like Theon don't count, Sansa stays a Stark through her marriages, and the tile Lyanna Mormont is a Mormont.

groups.title: House Lannister
groups.def: Born a Lannister: Tywin, his children Cersei, Jaime and Tyrion, and Cersei's three children by Jaime (Joffrey, Tommen, Myrcella), Lannisters by blood though styled Baratheon; like the other house groups, a wife only counts if she married the house's head or king, so Sansa (Tyrion's wife, and the wiki's 'Lannister by marriage') stays a Stark; the group avoids Sansa's groups.

groups.title: House Baratheon
groups.def: Born a Baratheon (Robert, Stannis, Renly, Shireen, and Gendry, Robert's bastard legitimised in S8), styled one as Robert's supposed children (Joffrey, Tommen, Myrcella), or the wife of a Baratheon king (Cersei, Robert's; Margaery, Renly's, Joffrey's and Tommen's); sworn men like Davos, Brienne, Loras and Beric don't count.

groups.title: House Targaryen
groups.def: Born a Targaryen, including Jon Snow, who is secretly Rhaegar and Lyanna Stark's trueborn son.

groups.title: House Greyjoy
groups.def: Born a Greyjoy.

groups.title: House Tyrell
groups.def: Born a Tyrell (Mace and his children Loras and Margaery, who stays a Tyrell though she married three Baratheon kings) or the wife of the house's head (Olenna, born a Redwyne, widow of Lord Luthor Tyrell).

groups.title: Dornish
groups.def: Dornish by birth and upbringing (wiki culture 'Dornishmen'): the Martells Oberyn, Doran and Trystane, and Oberyn's paramour Ellaria Sand; Jon was born at the Tower of Joy but raised in the North (culture Northmen), and Myrcella was born in King's Landing and only fostered in Dorne, so neither counts; the site's own classic data gives Jon's origin as Dorne, so the group avoids Jon's groups.

groups.title: House Tully
groups.def: Born a Tully.

groups.title: House Mormont
groups.def: Born a Mormont: Lord Commander Jeor, his son Jorah, his sister Maege (seen with Robb's bannermen in S1) and her daughter Lyanna; no Mormont wife is in the bank.

groups.title: King Robert's councillors
groups.def: Held a Small Council office under King Robert: Hand Ned, Master of Coin Littlefinger, Master of Whisperers Varys, Grand Maester Pycelle, Master of Laws Renly (all seen at the table in S1) and Master of Ships Stannis (away on Dragonstone); not Robert himself, Cersei, Jaime, or Lord Commander Barristan, whom Robert barred from the council (GOT305, GOT603), so the group avoids Kingsguard, and avoids Bran's councillors as the same office list in another reign.

groups.title: Kingsguard
groups.def: Sworn on screen into a king's or queen's Kingsguard/Queensguard at some point, even briefly or for a rival claimant: the Iron Throne's (Barristan, Jaime, Meryn Trant, the Hound until he deserts, the Mountain; Brienne and Podrick under Bran), Renly's (Loras, Brienne) or Daenerys's (Barristan, GOT301); Jorah is never named to her Queensguard on screen, so he's out and the group avoids his other groups; Podrick attends Bran's first council only as his guard, so the group avoids Bran's councillors.

groups.title: Night's Watch
groups.def: Took the black and served at the Wall as a sworn brother of the Night's Watch, including Mance Rayder, who deserted before the show began.

groups.title: Free Folk
groups.def: Born a wildling among the Free Folk beyond the Wall: Gilly (Craster's daughter), Tormund, Ygritte and Mance (born a wildling, raised by the Night's Watch, later King-Beyond-the-Wall); the Night King isn't one, and Jon only lives among them (the wiki adds 'Free Folk' to his culture after the finale), so the group avoids all of Jon's groups.

groups.title: Direwolves' owners
groups.def: The six Stark children who each found and raised one of the direwolf pups in Season 1.

groups.title: Monarchs on the Iron Throne
groups.def: Reigned as king or queen in their own right and sat the Iron Throne itself: Robert, Joffrey, Tommen and Cersei, the last to sit it; Ned and Tywin only sat it as Hand, queen consorts like Margaery never reigned, claimants (Stannis, Renly, Viserys) and Daenerys never sat it, and Bran is crowned after it's melted, so as 'the Iron Throne' also names the crown, the group avoids Bran's groups.

groups.title: Killed at a wedding feast
groups.def: Killed during a wedding feast on screen: the Red Wedding (Robb, Talisa, Catelyn) or the Purple Wedding (Joffrey); Edmure survives his own wedding as a prisoner, Walder Frey is killed later at an ordinary meal, and Maege's off-screen death 'fighting for Robb' is never placed at the Twins.

groups.title: Hand of the King or Queen
groups.def: Formally held the title Hand of the King or Hand of the Queen on screen, acting Hands and a claimant's Hand included: Ned (Robert), Tywin (Joffrey, Tommen), Tyrion (acting for Joffrey; Daenerys; Bran), Qyburn (Cersei) and Davos (Stannis); Mace is out, since on screen Cersei turns down his bid (GOT502) and his Hand-ship under Renly is book-only, and the group avoids his groups because the wiki's Hand page still lists him.
avoid: Died in the Great Sept blast

groups.title: The Five Kings
groups.def: The five crowned rivals the War of the Five Kings is named after: Joffrey, Robb, Stannis, Renly and Balon. Later monarchs (Tommen, Cersei, Euron, Jon) and other 'kings' (Mance, the Night King) aren't among the five.

groups.title: Masters of Coin
groups.def: Held the Small Council office of Master of Coin: Littlefinger (Robert, Joffrey), Tyrion (under Tywin), Mace (under Cersei) and Bronn (under Bran).

groups.title: Bran's councillors
groups.def: Sits on King Bran's Small Council in the finale: Hand Tyrion, Master of Coin Bronn, Master of Ships Davos, Grand Maester Sam and Lord Commander of the Kingsguard Brienne. Podrick only guards the king.

groups.title: Maesters
groups.def: Became a maester of the Citadel at some point: Aemon, Grand Maester Pycelle, Qyburn (chain later revoked) and Sam (Grand Maester in the finale); Oberyn only studied there as an acolyte (GOT403) and never became one, so the group avoids his groups.
avoid: Fought in a trial by combat

groups.title: Killed by their own blood
groups.def: Killed by a blood relative, directly or on their orders: Tywin (his son Tyrion), Renly (Stannis's shadow), Shireen (burned on her father Stannis's orders), Trystane (his cousin Obara), Balon (his brother Euron), Daenerys (her nephew Jon) and the Mountain (his brother the Hound); the Hound dies by his own leap in that fight, so he's out and the group avoids his groups; in-law killings (Joffrey, Lysa, Viserys, Rickon), Tommen's suicide and Doran (stabbed by Ellaria) don't count.
avoid: Fought in a trial by combat

groups.title: Fought in a trial by combat
groups.def: Fought as the accused or a champion in a formal trial by combat on screen: Bronn (for Tyrion, vs Vardis Egen), the Hound vs Beric, and Oberyn (for Tyrion) vs the Mountain; Tyrion and Cersei demanded trials but never fought, Jaime's offer to Robb was refused, and Jon's fight with Ramsay was a battle, but since the wiki calls it a 'de facto' trial the group avoids Jon's groups.

groups.title: On Arya's list
groups.def: Named in the kill list Arya recites every night, even briefly: Joffrey, Cersei, Tywin, the Mountain, the Hound, Walder Frey, Meryn Trant and Beric (added after the Brotherhood sold Gendry, later dropped). Littlefinger was never on it.

groups.title: Killed by Arya
groups.def: Killed by Arya Stark on screen: Meryn Trant (Braavos), Walder Frey (the Twins), Littlefinger (Winterfell) and the Night King.

groups.title: Wight-hunt party
groups.def: The hunting party that marched north of the Wall from Eastwatch in Season 7 to capture a wight: Jon, Jorah, Gendry, Tormund, the Hound and Beric (plus Thoros); Davos and Tyrion stay at Eastwatch, and Daenerys and Benjen only arrive to rescue them, but as the wiki lists them in the event, the group avoids their groups.

groups.title: Died in the Battle of Winterfell (S8)
groups.def: Died in the Season 8 battle against the dead at Winterfell ('The Long Night'): Jorah, Lyanna Mormont, Theon, Beric and the Night King himself; earlier fights at Winterfell don't count (Rickon dies in the S6 Battle of the Bastards, Stannis after the S5 battle in the ice), and the group avoids Kingsguard because Jorah is left out of it.

groups.title: Recast between seasons
groups.def: Played by a different actor partway through the show's run: Tommen, Myrcella, the Mountain (three actors), Dickon, Beric and the Night King. Unaired-pilot recasts (Catelyn, Daenerys) and younger flashback actors (Ned, Cersei, Benjen) don't count.

groups.title: Died in the Great Sept blast
groups.def: Killed when Cersei's wildfire destroyed the Great Sept of Baelor in the Season 6 finale: Margaery, Loras, Mace and the High Sparrow. Tommen's suicide and Pycelle's stabbing happen elsewhere.

groups.title: Titles & epithets, not names
groups.def: The tile is a byname or title, not the character's name: The Hound (Sandor), The Mountain (Gregor), Littlefinger (Petyr), Blackfish (Brynden), and the High Sparrow and Night King, who are never named. Short forms like Ned and Sam are still names.
